page.overview:
What is Haddonfield University?

Haddonfield University is a college located in the town of Haddonfield, Illinois. On October 31, 1995, the school held a fair to celebrate how Halloween was no longer banned in Haddonfield and invited radio personality Barry Simms to interview those who helped it return.

Barry would later be killed on the school grounds by Michael Myers. Seven years later, an upcoming production known as Dangertainment came to the school to search for students to enter the Myers house.
